name: agent-statusline-devtools
description: Dev-tooling only (NOT the application, NOT published). The statusline app is Python (installed via install.py / install.sh). This manifest pins the local aislop AI-slop tool so per-edit hooks can run a lockfile-integrity-verified binary (node_modules/.bin/aislop) instead of `npx --yes aislop@x` against the live registry. CI separately builds the fork commit in .aislop/fork-commit. The local package is the @schoen/aislop fork build (adds C#/roslynator + newer rules), served from the self-hosted Gitea npm registry (see .npmrc). Install with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`.
overridesComment: Patched TRANSITIVE dependencies of @schoen/aislop (dev tooling only). Advisory floors verified with npm audit and registry metadata 2026-09-30: fast-uri 3.1.8 (GHSA-hrr3-gc8f-f4qj), adm-zip 0.6.1 (seven advisories), hono 4.13.7 (GHSA-hxh3-vqpv-xpqv), ip-address 10.7.1 (GHSA-j6r3-76f7-8jcv and GHSA-h3mg-xc3c-68pw), smol-toml 1.7.1 (GHSA-7w5x-hrqm-74c2). These five packages use exact lowest patched versions to keep the security refresh narrow. Other existing floors remain unchanged. Drop an entry once the fork's dependency range excludes vulnerable versions.
